translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Galbbaa Harggiyaappe Pas'iyaa Asay Geeyiyaa Wogaa
Med'inaa Goday Musew hawaadan yaagiide odeedda;
«Wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggii oyk'k'eedda bitanii geeyiyaa gallassi ootsanaw koshshiyaa wogay hawaa. He bitaniyaa k'eesiyaakko afanaw koshshee.
K'eesii Asay dunkkaaneedda sa'aappe gas'aa kesiide, Aa harggiyaa be'o. He wode wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggii bitaniyaa bollaappe d'ayeeddawaa gidooppe,
k'eesii pas'a de'iyaa laa"u geeshsha kafotuwaa, s'idiyaa mitsaa, zo'o k'ac'inaanne hisoop'p'iyaa bonc'c'iyaa he wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggiyaappe geeyiyaa bitaniyaa diraw ahanaadan unttuntta azazo.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, k'ay k'eesii laa"u kafotuwaappe ittuwaa keriyaan de'iyaa pultto haatsaa bolla shukkanaadan azazo.
Pas'a de'iyaa kafuwaa, k'ay zigaanna, zo'o k'ac'inaananne hisoop'p'iyaa bonc'c'iyaanna akki afiide, keriyaan de'iyaa pulttiyaa haatsaa bolla shukkeedda kafuwaa suutsaa giddo naak'k'o.
Kesseedda suutsaa he wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggiyaappe pas'iyaa bitaniyaa bolla laappu gede c'ac'c'afo; yaatiide he bitanii geeshsha gidiyaawaa erisso; pas'a de'iyaa kafuwaa gede dembbaa yeddo.

«He harggiyaappe geeyeedda bitanii bare mayuwaa meec'c'o; bare bollan de'iyaa isikiyaa ubbaa meedetto; bare bollaakka meec'etto; yaatooppe I geeshsha gidanawaa. Hewaappe guyyiyaan, I dunkkaaneedda sa'aa yo; shin gidooppenne bare dunkkaaniyaa gelennaan laappun gallassaa karenna gam"o.

Laappuntsa gallassan bare huup'iyaa, buuchchaa, goomaanne bare bollan de'iyaa hara isikiyaa ubbaa meedetto; k'ay bare mayuwaa meec'c'o; bare bollaakka meec'etto; Hewaappe guyyiyaan, I geeshsha gidanawaa.

«Hosppuntsa gallassan tilla bollaanna de'iyaa laa"u dorssaa maratuwaanne itti laytsaa gideedda itti dorssato aho; k'ay katsaa yarshshoo zayitiyaan munak'etteedda usuppun kiilo giraame d'iiliyaanne itti liitiro wogaraa zayitiyaw heezzentso kushiyaa aho.
Aa geeshshiyaa k'eesii bitaniyaa I aheedawanttuna ittippekka Med'inaa Godaa Dunkkaaniyaa pengge Med'inaa Godaa sintsa shiishsho.

«K'eesiikka laa"u dorssaa maratuwaappe ittuwaa akkiide, liitiro heezzentso kushiyaa zayitiyaanna ittippe naak'uwaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide shiishsho; he shiishsheeddawaa k'ay k'aatsiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide Med'inaa Godaa sintsan k'aatso.
Yaatiide I he dorssaa maraa nagaraa yarshshuwaanne s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa shukkiyaa geeshsha sa'aan shukko; nagaraa yarshshuwaadan naak'uwaa yarshshuukka k'eesiyaw imettee; ikka loytsi geeshsha.
K'eesii naak'uwaa yarshshuwaa suutsaappe guutsaa akkiide, he geeyiyaa bitaniyaw ushechcha bagga haytsaa s'eeraa, ushechcha kushiyaw wogga birad'd'iyaanne ushechcha gediyaw wogga birad'd'iyaa okko.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, k'eesii wogaraa zayitiyaappe guutsaa akkiide, bare haddirssa kushiyaa gomppan tigo.
«He haddirssa kushiyaa gomppan de'iyaa wogaraa zayitiyaan bare ushechcha kushiyaa birad'd'iyaa naak'k'iide, Med'inaa Godaa sintsan laappu gede c'ac'c'afo.

Yaati simmiide bare kushiyaa gomppan atteeda zayitiyaappe akkiide, geeyiyaa bitaniyaw ushechcha haytsaa s'eeraa, ushechcha kushiyaw wogga birad'd'iyaanne ushechcha gediyaw wogga birad'd'iyaa kase naak'uwaa yarshshuwaa suutsaa oketteedda sa'aan okko.
K'ay bare kushiyaa gomppan atteeda zayitiyaa k'eesii geeyiyaa bitaniyaa huup'iyaan gusso; yaatiide Med'inaa Godaa sintsan he bitaniyaa nagaraa atto giisso.

«Hewaappe guyyiyaan k'eesii bare tunatetsaappe geeyiyaa bitaniyaa nagaraa atto giissanaw nagaraa yarshshoo shiishsheedda mehiyaa shukkee; hewaappe simmiide k'ay s'uuggiyaa yarshshoo shiishsheedda mehiyaa yarshshee.
K'ay k'eesii he s'uuggiyaa yarshshuwaa katsaa yarshshuwaanna ittippe yarshshiyaa sa'aa bollan wotsiide s'uuggee; yaatiide bitaniyaa nagaraa atto giissee; bitaniikka geeshsha gidee.

«Shin bitanii hewaa ubbaa ahanaw danddayenna mank'k'o gidooppe, S'oossaa sintsan k'aatsiide Aa nagaraa atto giissanaw, bare naak'uwaa yarshshoo itti dorssaa maraa aho. K'ay katsaa yarshshookka wogaraa zayitiyaan munak'etteedda laa"u kiilo giraame lo"o d'iiliyaanne itti liitiro heezzentso kushiyaa zayitiyaa ittippe aho.
K'aykka barew danddayeeddawaadan laa"u maraa harap'p'etuwaa woy laa"u mara dogomattuwaa, ittuwaa nagaraa yarshshoo, ittuwaa k'ay s'uuggiyaa yarshshoo aho.
«Hosppuntsa gallassan bare nagaraappe geeyanaw bitanii hawantta k'eesiyaakko Med'inaa Godaa Dunkkaaniyaa pengge Med'inaa Godaa sintsa aho.
K'eesii naak'uwaa yarshshoo aheedda dorssaa maraanne littiro heezentso kushe zayitiyaa akkiide, k'aatsiyaa yarshshuwaa ootsiide Med'inaa Godaa sintsan k'aatso.

Yaatiide naak'uwaa yarshshoo aheedda dorssaa maraa shukkiide he naak'uwaa yarshshuwaa suutsaappe guutsaa akkiide, ha geeyiyaa bitaniyaw ushechcha haytsaa s'eeraa, ushechcha kushiyaw wogga birad'd'iyaanne ushechcha gediyaw wogga birad'd'iyaa okko.
K'ay k'eesii zayitiyaappe guutsaa bare haddirssa kushiyaa gomppan tigo.
He haddirssa kushiyaa gomppan de'iyaa zayitiyaappe ushechcha kushiyaa s'eeran guutsaa akkiide, Med'inaa Godaa sintsan laappu gede c'ac'c'afo.

K'aykka k'eesii bare kushiyaa gomppan de'iyaa zayitiyaappe guutsaa akkiide, geeyiyaa bitaniyaw ushechcha haytsaa s'eeraa, ushechcha kushiyaw wogga birad'd'iyaanne ushechcha gediyaw wogga birad'd'iyaa kase naak'uwaa yarshshuwaa suutsaa oketteedda sa'aan okko.
K'ay Med'inaa Godaa sintsan bitaniyaa nagaraa atto giissanaw, k'eesii bare kushiyaan atteeda zayitiyaa geeyiyaa bitaniyaa huup'iyaan okko.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, he aawuu barew danddayeeddawaadan harap'p'iyaa maraa gidina woy mara dogommuwaa gidina,
ittuwaa nagaraa yarshshoo laa"entsuwaa k'ay s'uuggiyaa yarshshoo katsaa yarshshuwaanna ittippe yarshsho. K'ay k'eesiikka he geeyiyaa bitaniyaw Med'inaa Godaa sintsan Aa nagaraa atto giisso.
Bare bollan de'iyaa wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggiyaappe geeyanaw koshshiyaa wogaa polanaw mank'k'otay diggeedda uraw de'iyaa wogay simmi hawaa» yaageedda.
Golliyaa Bolla Kesiyaa Borok'uwaa
Med'inaa Goday Musanne Aaroona hawaadan yaageedda,
«Taani hinttenttoo ak'o ootsaade immiyaa Kanaane biittaa hintte geliyaa wode, k'ay he gadiyaan de'iyaa hintte keetsaappe ittuwaan taani borok'uwaa yeddiyaa wode,
he golliyaw k'eesiyaakko biide, ‹Ta son ayaa borok'entto de'ee› yaagiide odo.
Gollen de'iyaabay ubbay tuna geetettennaadan, k'eesii borok'uwaa be'anaw gelanaappe kasetiide, son de'iyaawaa ubbaa kare kessanaadan azazo; yaati simmina k'eesii be'anaw golle gelo.
Hewaan be'iyaa wode, borok'o sa'ay godaa bollan maataa malatiyaa, woy zo'o malaa bessooppenne k'ay godaappe ollatiide giddo gelooppe,
k'eesii golleppe kare kesiide, golliyaa laappun gallassaa gakkanaw gorddo.
Laappuntsa gallassaan k'eesii he golliyaa zaaretsiide; s'eelliyaa wode he borok'uu golliyaa godaa bollan aakkooppe,
borok'uu de'iyaa shuchchatuwaa ubbaa godaappe shoddiide, katamaappe gas'aa yaa tuneedda sa'aw olanaadan azazo.
K'ay godaa dufeedda urk'k'aa soo baggana bookkishin, yuushshi aatsiide k'ok'k'ofanaadan ootso; yaatiide he k'ok'k'ofeedda urk'k'aa katamaappe gas'an de'iyaa tuna sa'aan olino.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, he shoddeedda shuchchatuu sa'aan hara shuchchatuwaa wotsino; k'ay hara urk'k'ankka golliyaa dufino.
«Shuchchatuwaa shod diggina, k'ay urk'k'aakka k'ok'k'ofiide hara urk'k'aa dufii simmina, laa"entsuwaa simmiide borok'uu golliyaa giddon aakkooppe,
k'eesii hewaa be'iyaa wode; borok'uu he golliyaa giddon aakkooppe, hewe ittuwaappe ittuwaa oyk'k'iyaa borok'o gidiyaa diraw, he gollii tuna.
Hewaa diraw I he golliyaa, Aa shuchchaa, Aa mitsaanne I dufeteedda urk'k'aa ubbaa kolo; hewantta katamaappe gas'aa afiide, tuna sa'aan olo.
K'ay he gollii gorddan takkiyaa wodiyaan Aa giddo geliyaa ooninne sa'ay k'ammana gakkanaw tuna.
He golliyaan gisiyaa uray woy k'umaa miyaa uray bare mayuwaa meec'c'o.
«Shin k'eesii yiide s'eelliyaa wode, gollii dufetti simmina laa"entsuwaa simmiide aakkana d'ayooppe, borok'uu d'ayeedda diraw, he gollii geeshsha gidiyaawaa k'eesii erisso.
Golliyaa geeshshanaw laa"u kafotuwaa, s'idiyaa mitsaa, zo'o k'ac'inaanne hisoop'p'iyaa bonc'c'iyaa aho.
Kafotuwaappe ittuwaa keriyaan de'iyaa pulttuwaa haatsaa bollan shukko.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan s'idiyaa, hisoop'p'iyaa bonc'c'iyaa, zo'o k'ac'inaanne pas'a de'iyaa kafuwaa ittippe akkiide, keriyaan de'iyaa shukkeedda kafuwaa suutsaaninne pulttuwaa haatsaan yeggi kessiide, laappu gede he golliyaa c'ac'c'afo.
Yaatiide he golliyaa k'eesii kafuwaa suutsan, pulttuwaa haatsaan, pas'a de'iyaa kafuwaan, s'idiyaan, hisoop'p'iyaa bonc'c'iyaaninne zo'o k'ac'inan geeshsho.
K'ay pas'a de'iyaa kafuwaa katamaappe gas'aa hini dembbaa yeddo. Hewaadan ootsiide, golliyaa geeshshiyaa wogaa polee; golliikka geeshsha gidee.
«Ay wolk'k'aama galbbaa hargge gidooppekka hawe woga; k'aac'echchiyaawaa gidina,
mayuwaa bollan woy golliyaa bollan kesiyaa borok'o gidina,
gaafuwaa gidina, d'uussa madutsaa gidina woy ilahuwaa gidinakka,
ittibay tuna gidiyaawaanne geeshsha gidiyaawaa erissanaw wolk'k'aama galbbaa harggiyaanne borok'uwaa wogay hawaa» yaageedda.
